business_overview.one_sentence: The group operates Hong Kong property investment/development, ferry and shipyard services, medical/healthcare/beauty services, and securities investment.
business_overview.revenue_model: Rental income, ferry and shipyard service income, medical/beauty service income, securities dividends/interest, and occasional property development/project income.
business_notes: Substantially all revenue and operating profit are derived from Hong Kong activities.
2025 profit was mainly affected by rental income, bank interest, investment property valuation gains, and a one-off construction cost adjustment in a joint venture development project.
The group stated it had no borrowings at 31 December 2025.

profit_cash_conversion.assessment: Three-year operating cash flow is much weaker than accounting profit because property development working capital and project/JV gains dominate; 2025 operating profit before working-capital movement was HK$48.423m and maintenance PPE capex was estimated from the three-year median at HK$6.083m.

Annual Report 2025 consolidated cash flow statement, HK$'000

gaps: The annual report does not split cash by listed parent versus individual subsidiaries; all principal subsidiaries listed are Hong Kong incorporated.
No explicit restricted-cash line was found; absence is treated as evidence but not as proof that every deposit can be immediately distributed.
Maintenance capex is not separately disclosed; estimated from three-year PPE purchase median, excluding investment property additions.
Working-capital reinvestment is volatile due to property development inventory; main profit denominator uses operating profit before working-capital changes with an additional haircut.
